title: The best investment during our trip
text: This tour was the best investment we made during our trip so far. So much knowledge was shared with us that we would not know otherwise. The tour guide was so kind and always made sure everyone was there before sharing new information and shared his umbrella with us Arizonians who did not bring one to keep our daughter dry. Besides that, he was very knowledgeable and easy to understand. Absolutely loved it
author: B3910XRmariad

title: This is a fun and...
text: This is a fun and informative tour. The guide speaks good English and has good sense of humor. Our tour guide was absolutely phenomenal! Out of all the guides we encountered during our trip to Spain and Portugal, their English was by far the absolute best. Every explanation was incredibly clear, exceptionally well-structured, and easy to follow. They have a wonderful talent for making history and culture come alive, balancing deep knowledge with a highly engaging and entertaining storytelling style. We never felt bored for a single second. If you want an insightful, seamless, and genuinely fun
author: Xin_Z

title: Do the tour!
text: This tour is a definite must when visiting Park Guell. Our guide Marc P. was super knowledgeable and engaging. He guided us through the essential sites, and we had plenty of time to tour the rest of the park on our own after the tour. I was so glad we booked this tour. I learned so much! Thank you to the tour operators who made it very easy to find our guide. We booked last minute and even received a text from the touring company to ensure we met up with the guide- over the top customer service, thank you!
author: Christina_M

title: Highly recommend
text: Cool guide. Good explanation. Nice location. Uncomplicated and helpful. We enjoyed it and can recommend the tour.
author: Elif_O

title: Guided tour, a must!
text: Our tour guide was great and we really enjoyed the tour. I recommend having a guided tour at Park Guell, you will get way more information than just walking around on your own.
author: Casey_T

title: Raoul was a phenomenal...
text: Raoul was a phenomenal host and showed us the park from his perspective from when he played there as a child. He highlighted the important features and history of the Park mixed in with a great story of his youth.  We would highly recommend him for your tour!
